dataset: BAF Base.csv, official Kaggle sgpjesus version 2, 1000000 rows
scope: Data audit, supervised benchmarks, unsupervised baseline, SHAP, distilled rules, age fairness, temporal drift
preprocessing: Train-only category levels, train-only constants, numeric median with missing indicators; standardization and one-hot for LR/MLP/IF/tree; LightGBM uses native categories and NaNs

candidates.lightgbm_configs_note: Three paired configurations as actually run in src/train.py (larger trees get stronger L2), not a 3x3 grid. Corrected 2026-10-18; the earlier text listed the two parameters separately, which read like a full grid.
candidates.lightgbm_early_stopping: validation average precision, patience60, at most900 trees
candidates.mlp_epochs: at most30, validation recall/AP patience6 after epoch10
candidates.isolation_forest: one fixed config:250 trees,max_samples4096; no fit/parameter-selection labels
candidates.distillation: Regress teacher training log-odds, depth3 or4, max5 leaves, min_leaf0.5%; choose validation same-budget recall then teacher Spearman

class_imbalance: Balanced class/sample weights for LR, LightGBM and MLP; no synthetic resampling
threshold: Lowest validation score threshold satisfying whole-tie FPR<=5%; freeze before test
model_selection: Validation recall under5% FPR, AP tie-break
pr_auc: Average precision(AP) primary; trapezoidal PR-AUC also exported
equal_budget: Fix budget fraction from validation LightGBM alert rate, then exact topK using unlabeled target-month scores; ties use seed42 row hash
fairness: Same global frozen threshold, age<50 vs age>=50, FPR gap/ratio and Wilson95% intervals; include >50 sensitivity
monthly: Months0-5 explicitly in-sample, month6 validation, month7 final held-out; no claim of eight independent out-of-time tests
uncertainty: Wilson95% binomial intervals for held-out FPR/recall; paired stratified bootstrap500 for held-out same-budget teacher-minus-rules recall gap, fixed predictions
test_policy: No month7 prediction or model selection before frozen_manifest.json is written; final evaluation code consumes frozen models only

post_hoc_extensions.added: 2026-10-18, after the month-7 evaluation had been seen; exploratory, never re-selects the frozen winner
invariants: frozen artifacts read only; SHA-256 recorded before/after and re-checked in src/verify.py
new fits use months 0-5; early stopping, thresholds and the recommended rule size use month 6 only; month 7 reported only
post_hoc_extensions.rule_complexity: DecisionTreeRegressor on teacher training log-odds, max_leaf_nodes in [5,8,12,16,24,32,48,64], min_samples_leaf 0.5%; whole-leaf threshold at validation FPR<=5%; recommended = fewest leaves with validation whole-leaf recall >= 90% of teacher validation recall; if no candidate reaches the target, report target_met=false and choose highest validation whole-leaf recall (fewest leaves breaks ties) as a fallback, not a target-achieving recommendation
post_hoc_extensions.feature_ablation: LightGBM with frozen hyper-parameters (31 leaves, reg_lambda 10) refit after dropping: nothing (reproduction check), customer_age, velocity_6h+velocity_24h, all velocity_*
post_hoc_extensions.fairness: base fraud rate per age group; no-age refit; per-group thresholds (each validation group FPR<=5%) as a trade-off reference only; age-proxy LightGBM predicting age>=50 from the other inputs
post_hoc_extensions.uncertainty: paired positive-class bootstrap (500) for same-budget recall differences; stratified bootstrap (500) for AP differences; fixed predictions

post_hoc_rolling_backtest.added: 2026-10-18, after all eight months had already been inspected; retrospective robustness only
post_hoc_rolling_backtest.baseline_selection: Each window independently selects among the original three paired LightGBM configurations using only its own validation recall under FPR<=5%, AP tie-break; no reuse of the final-window winner for earlier windows
post_hoc_rolling_backtest.ablation_hyperparameters: Same as that window baseline, with independent validation early stopping and threshold selection
post_hoc_rolling_backtest.capacity: Predeclared 5% of applications in every test month for all variants; distinct from the main experiment validation-derived 5.6412%
post_hoc_rolling_backtest.uncertainty: 500 paired age-by-label-stratified bootstrap draws on fixed predictions; no refitting or threshold re-estimation; monthly range is not a confidence interval
post_hoc_rolling_backtest.test_policy: Persist per-window model/schema/validation predictions/threshold manifest before scoring its test month. Report all four variants; never choose a winner from retrospective test results. Preserve original main artifacts.
